name: cascader
title: Cascader
description: A select with a column per level for nested choices like country, state, city. Keyboard friendly; gives the full path.
htmlExample: <bef-cascader :options='[{"value":"in","label":"India","children":[{"value":"mh","label":"Maharashtra","children":[{"value":"mum","label":"Mumbai"},{"value":"pun","label":"Pune"},{"value":"nag","label":"Nagpur"}]},{"value":"ka","label":"Karnataka","children":[{"value":"blr","label":"Bengaluru"},{"value":"mys","label":"Mysuru"}]},{"value":"dl","label":"Delhi","children":[{"value":"ndl","label":"New Delhi"}]}]},{"value":"us","label":"United States","children":[{"value":"ca","label":"California","children":[{"value":"sf","label":"San Francisco"},{"value":"la","label":"Los Angeles"}]},{"value":"ny","label":"New York","children":[{"value":"nyc","label":"New York City"}]}]},{"value":"sg","label":"Singapore"}]' :value='["in","mh","pun"]' placeholder="Country / state / city" emit="change"></bef-cascader>
